Interface ICellCollider

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.CellCollision
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents an object that can participate in the cell-based collision system. Implementers are queried for position, collision layer/mask and receive lifecycle callbacks when they enter/exit cells or start/end collisions with other colliders.

public interface ICellCollider

Returns the collision layer bit for this collider. Layers are represented as a uint bitmask where a single bit denotes the layer.
